I don’t see any media files attached yet. Please upload the files (or share links) so I can help analyze them.

If you can, also tell me:
- What type of analysis you want (e.g., describe the content, identify objects, read visible text via OCR, extract metadata like EXIF, analyze colors, summarize audio, etc.)
- Any constraints or goals (e.g., focus on a specific person, color palette, or text in a language)

Note: I can help with descriptive analysis based on the media you provide here. If you also need weather or current time, I can fetch that for a location you specify.
